title: Prefill-decode backpressure synchronizer with micro-chunking and KV shadow coalescing
author: Samira Patel
description:
Motivation: In high-concurrency serving workloads the prefill->decode pipeline can collapse under transient bursts: aggressive prefill bursts saturate KV cache bandwidth and GPU kernel queues while slow decodes backpressure request handling, resulting in token stalls and increased p99 latency. Existing chunking/speculative prefill work reduces some of this but doesn't uniformly apply backpressure or coalesce KV reads when many small prefill windows target overlapping keys.

What this PR does: Implements a lightweight synchronizer that enforces adaptive backpressure between prefill and decode stages, plus a micro-chunking prefill formatter and a KV shadow coalescer. Key behaviors: (1) dynamic token-budget backpressure: the prefill stage is throttled based on the decode-stage headroom metric (decode inflight tokens + kernel queue depth) instead of a static window; (2) micro-chunking: prefill requests split into small, aligned micro-chunks (typical 8-32 token units) that allow earlier KV priming for long sequences while keeping kernel launch sizes efficient; (3) KV shadow coalescer: in-memory transient index that detects overlapping KV reads from concurrent micro-chunks and merges them into a single backend fetch if within a configurable timebound (default 6ms); (4) graceful degrade to speculative-prefill: when coalescing is not effective or KV backend is slow, the synchronizer reduces prefill aggressiveness and instructs the scheduler to fall back to decode-first for low-latency requests.

Implementation notes: single-threaded hot-path changes are minimal. New components: runtime/pipeline/backpressure_synchronizer.{cpp,h} (core logic, metrics), runtime/pipeline/microchunk_formatter.cc (split/merge heuristics), kv/shadow_coalescer.cc (in-memory coalescer w/ eviction TTL), scheduler/handoff_manager.rs (exposes headroom metric to sync). Integration points: the prefill worker obtains a BackpressureTokenLease before issuing micro-chunks; the decode worker publishes headroom updates periodically (every 1ms) and on kernel completion. Metrics added: prefill.backpressure_throttled_ratio, kv.shadow_coalesce_rate, prefill.microchunk_size_hist, pipeline.headroom_ns.

Compatibility and safety: feature is behind runtime flag --prefill-backpressure-enabled (disabled by default in release branches). Default micro-chunk sizes and coalesce window are conservatively tuned to avoid regression on current benchmarks. There is a fast-path that bypasses coalescer for prefill requests with explicit KV pinning.

Testing and perf: unit tests and integration harness added in tests/pipeline/*; end-to-end perf harness updated to exercise bursty arrival patterns and long-sequence scenarios. Local cluster runs show median token latency unchanged, p95 reduced by ~7%, p99 reduced by ~18% on mixed burst workloads, and KV backend request count reduced 12% due to shadow coalescing.

Commits (summary):
- Add backpressure synchronizer core and header, basic metrics and tests
- Implement micro-chunk prefill formatter + API for chunk leases
- KV shadow coalescer with TTL + merge logic and unit tests
- Wire scheduler headroom publishing and update prefill worker handoff
- Add runtime flag, config knobs and docs for tuning
- Fix flaky timing in coalescer tests; update perf harness scenarios

Files changed (high-level):
- runtime/pipeline/backpressure_synchronizer.cpp (.h) — core algorithm and leases
- runtime/pipeline/microchunk_formatter.cc — chunking heuristics
- kv/shadow_coalescer.cc — in-memory coalescer + eviction
- scheduler/handoff_manager.rs — headroom export stub + tests
- runtime/metrics/registry.cc — new metrics registration
- tests/pipeline/prefill_backpressure_test.cc — integration tests

Review thread (selected):
- Alex Gomez (review): "Overall approach looks promising. A few nitpicks: can we avoid global timer wakes for headroom updates? Also please double-check the lease revocation path for prefill micro-chunks — I saw a possible race when decode worker dies mid-lease."
- Samira (author): "Addressed: switched to event-driven publish from decode completion + keep an opt-in 1ms periodic tick for coarse metrics. Added explicit revoke sequence in synchronizer and added a test that simulates decode worker crash."
- Priya Shah (review): "KV coalescer complexity looks reasonable, but the eviction TTL will be critical. Suggest exposing a percentile-based adaptive TTL later. Approving after one more safety test."
- Samira: "Added adaptive eviction test that simulates skewed key reuse; left adaptive TTL as follow-up (ENG-2011)."
- Marek Novak (review): "Bench numbers look good. Two comments on instrumentation labels (use existing metric names) and a small memory accounting bug in coalescer — please patch."
- Samira: "Fixed metric naming to match registry conventions; added unit test for coalescer memory accounting. Ran CI again."
- Linus Berg (final): "Approach and tests LGTM. Approving to merge."

CI checks: build (pass), unit-tests (pass after rerun; initial run had one flaky timing test fail), lint (pass), perf-smoke (pass), e2e (pass). Rerun history: unit-tests failed once (tests/pipeline/timing_test flaky); fixed test by relaxing timing bound and adding mocked clock in coalescer tests.

Merge: squash and merge on main. Merge commit: 8c7a3f9d5b4e2a1f3d9c1e0b4a7f2a01c3d4e5f6

Release notes: "Introduce opt-in prefill/decode backpressure synchronizer with micro-chunking and KV shadow coalescing. Reduces p99 latency and KV backend load on bursty workloads. Disabled by default; operators should enable and tune via --prefill-backpressure-enabled and microchunk/coalesce knobs. See docs/runtime/prefill_backpressure.md for tuning guidance."
